hints.text: Both terms are $x$-terms — the same kind of sticker.
Four $x$ stickers plus three $x$ stickers. Add the front numbers: $4 + 3$.

explanation: $4x$ and $3x$ are like terms — same variable part.

alternativeExplanations.title: Sticker sorting
steps: Picture 4 apple stickers and 3 more apple stickers — all the same kind.
Same kind means you can count them together: 7 apple stickers, so 7x.

alternativeExplanations.title: Test a value
steps: And 7x = 14 too — the shorter form gives the same value, so 7x is right.
